title: Candle absence vetoes a buy
reason: Intraday, Short, Swing and Positional call candle_confirmation and continue on failure; the owner clarified candles should assist selection.
impact: A qualified candidate stops before sizing. Five such refusals were recorded in the earlier 3 November scan; one was later owner-bought.
fix: Separate pattern detection from enforcement. Use advisory candles across the five streams, preserving evidence and ordinary risk checks.
acceptance: No-pattern candidate reaches later checks in both engine and backtest; existing risk failures still reject.
proof: Source plus earlier dated production scan

title: Timing failure loses its detailed reason
reason: Timing computes price-distance and volume-ratio diagnostics but persists only a boolean; initial rejection can retain a blank outcome.
impact: High-score shares appear selected without a clear reason why they were excluded; 31 earlier scan rows had timing=false.
fix: Persist each input, threshold, failed subcondition, bar time and explicit pass/fail/not_evaluated/data_missing state.
acceptance: Save/reload distinguishes price failure, volume failure and insufficient history.
proof: Source plus earlier dated production scan

title: Intraday selection still consumes daily bars
reason: Intraday preset metadata says 5m/5d, but the scan uses fetch_daily. Settings does now disclose daily bars.
impact: A pattern or timing verdict is daily context, not fresh five-minute confirmation.
fix: Make timeframe an explicit enforced contract. Either retain labelled daily-context Intraday or add completed 5m/15m execution data under an approved policy.
acceptance: Selected timeframe reaches provider, indicator and saved evidence; incomplete bars excluded.
proof: Source review; no claim all screens mislabel this

title: Price and volume evidence can be imposed repeatedly
reason: Breakout/volume affect score, the timing condition and some candle patterns.
impact: A strong score may face repeated correlated requirements; extra patterns alone do not resolve that design.
fix: Map each feature to eligibility, timing or advisory evidence. Compare policies on identical candidates before changing timing thresholds.
acceptance: Replay identifies each rule's incremental refusals and outcomes without using future bars.

title: Incomplete OHLC can produce a confirmed candle
reason: The breakout check validates column presence/Close count but not all latest OHLC values; NaN comparisons can pass and volume dropna can substitute an older bar.
impact: Bad data can appear as bullish evidence and currently pass the entry veto.
fix: Validate finite, coherent OHLCV over the exact pattern window; return data_missing instead of a pattern verdict.
acceptance: Missing latest high/low/volume never confirms breakout; valid pattern still does.
proof: Synthetic latest High/Low NaN breakout returned True

title: Missing volume passes liquidity
reason: Five-day rupee-turnover mean can be NaN; NaN < threshold is false.
impact: The turnover protection can report pass when there was no valid recent volume.
fix: Require finite aligned closes/volumes and explicit recent coverage; distinguish missing data from low liquidity.
acceptance: All-missing, partial, zero and negative volume fixtures cannot produce false clearance.

title: Correlation ignores new names in the same batch
reason: open_returns is built from pre-scan holdings; all candidates are checked before opens and newly accepted names are not added.
impact: Several highly correlated candidates may enter together despite the configured rule.
fix: Evaluate against the projected accepted book in order, and recheck after rotation or concurrent portfolio changes.
acceptance: Two candidates above correlation limit in an initially empty book cannot both bypass the rule.

title: Unmeasured correlation looks like clearance
reason: Insufficient history or overlap returns None, the same result as no blocker.
impact: The owner cannot distinguish measured diversification from absent evidence.
fix: Return sample/coverage status and expose unknown separately; make missing-data handling an explicit policy.
acceptance: No-data result displays not evaluated; measured-low correlation displays pass.
proof: Source review; current permissive fallback is not automatically a policy bug

title: New-entry heat uses a different stop from the actual trade
reason: can_open uses category stop percentage; the later Momentum stop can widen under ATR.
impact: Actual post-open risk-at-stop can exceed the heat limit even after the gate passed.
fix: Compute the proposed stop before sizing, and use that same stop for risk and the opened position.
acceptance: With 5% category/15% actual stop, size or reject using 15%; post-open heat stays within cap.
proof: Isolated INR100,000 book accepted 1,000 shares at100: counted risk5,000 versus15,000 at stop85; no trade placed

title: Market-data failure can become a neutral regime
reason: fetch_regime returns a neutral, Everest-active fallback on errors/insufficient data; engine exception protection does not catch a successful fallback return.
impact: Unknown market conditions can relax protection and reserve calculations.
fix: Represent unknown/degraded separately; preserve last valid regime with its time and an explicit data-loss policy.
acceptance: Provider failure after panic/correction cannot silently create a fresh neutral observation.

title: Earnings calendar is out of date
reason: Ticker earnings data is a static July-August 2026 list; absence of later events produces no blackout.
impact: No-event can be mistaken for a verified check of upcoming results.
fix: Load announced dates with source/as-of/coverage; distinguish no known event from stale calendar. Preserve the current window until approved otherwise.
acceptance: Future announced event exercises the window; expired calendar reports unknown.

title: Delayed quote loses its age
reason: The fallback receives price plus timestamp but retains only price/source; a positive old value can be used.
impact: Entry/exit simulation can use a stale value while the decision is dated now.
fix: Carry price, observed_at, received_at, source and per-purpose usability; separate display marks from executable quote policy.
acceptance: An old one-minute timestamp stays old and is rejected/deferred under the approved freshness rule.
proof: Injected old timestamp accepted by current fallback; not proof stale production fills occurred

title: Quote validation accepts positive infinity
reason: Router's positive-number comparison does not require finiteness.
impact: Non-finite prices can contaminate sizing, marks or exits.
fix: Require finite positive prices at provider and command boundaries; preserve source error evidence.
acceptance: NaN, +inf, -inf and invalid types never become usable quotes.
proof: Injected +inf accepted by current quote route

title: Saved liquidity is only a partial liquidity check
reason: Momentum shortlist recomputes historical liquidity without the live bid/ask inputs used by the entry path.
impact: A row labelled liquid can still be blocked by spread, appearing contradictory.
fix: Show turnover, circuit and spread separately, with source/time and not-evaluated states.
acceptance: High turnover plus wide spread shows pass for turnover and fail/unknown for spread, not blanket clearance.

title: Scores conceal missing-input coverage
reason: Some scoring components use a neutral value of50 when data is missing.
impact: Two equal scores can have very different evidence quality.
fix: Display observed/imputed component counts and provenance without silently changing numeric scoring.
acceptance: Equal-score fixtures with different coverage have visibly different evidence summaries.

title: Database operations have no explicit total deadline in code
reason: Mongo client sets connect/server-selection timeouts only. Exit work holds mode lock while saving; rotation takes the same lock.
impact: A slow responding database could delay later scans and exit checks. A live stall is not proved; URI-level timeout settings were not inspected.
fix: Bound read/write operations and lock waits; checkpoint progress and surface timeout/deferred work. Do not merely abandon a mutating worker thread.
acceptance: Injected stalled read/write terminates within deadline; protection checks are retried and failed saves are visible.
proof: Source-confirmed missing explicit operation/socket deadline; runtime configuration unknown

title: Rotation can sell before replacement approval
reason: _rotation_exits runs after preliminary checks but before final can_open sizing/risk checks.
impact: A holding can be sold to fund a replacement later rejected by heat, sector, kill switch or size; advisory candles would expose more candidates to this path.
fix: Evaluate the projected post-rotation portfolio with the same final risk/sizing rules before any sale; version and revalidate the funding plan.
acceptance: Preliminary pass plus final rejection causes no sale; a valid funded replacement executes coherently.

title: Danger rules discard NumPy true values
reason: Evaluator uses identity comparison is True; numpy.bool_(True) is not the Python True singleton.
impact: Warnings and protective actions can be omitted despite a rule firing.
fix: Normalize valid scalar boolean outputs while preserving unknown and evaluation errors; assess changed action frequency before rollout.
acceptance: Python and NumPy true agree, false remains false, None abstains and exceptions remain visible.
proof: Injected Python True counted; equivalent NumPy True ignored

title: Danger sector/index context reads July data
reason: externals_for reads committed external panels with their default final date, not a current aligned evaluation date.
impact: Current holdings can receive protection decisions using old sector/index context.
fix: Use stored current external bars aligned to the holding's evaluation bar; explicitly abstain on stale inputs; preserve historical as-of semantics.
acceptance: Current holding plus old panel shows stale-input abstention; historical replay never reads future data.
proof: Local TCS external context returned asof/index_asof 2026-07-17

title: Overnight Intraday conversion leaves inconsistent exit identity
reason: Startup retagging applies Momentum stop/target to stale Intraday holdings without changing position.mode; later exit config still reads Intraday.
impact: A position can have Momentum levels, Intraday trailing/holding rules and contradictory journal identity.
fix: Decide failed-square-off policy explicitly: retain Intraday plus pending exit, or fully convert strategy and policy snapshots together. Preserve original stream and custom-level history.
acceptance: Repeated restart retains one coherent approved policy and an auditable conversion; no incidental stop widening.
proof: Fake100-entry position changed stops/targets98.5/102.5 to95/120; mode remained Intraday, journal said Momentum

title: Square-off has no durable retry obligation
reason: Missing quote at mandatory square-off is journaled and holding stays open, without a dedicated pending obligation like the repaired drawdown path.
impact: A missed same-day exit can become overnight exposure without clear retry ownership.
fix: Persist identity-bound square-off obligations, attempts, next retry and escalation; execute only with usable quotes in allowed hours.
acceptance: Missing quote survives restart as pending; returned quote closes once; replacement holding of same ticker is not accidentally closed.
proof: Existing refusal to invent a fill is correct and must remain

title: Deferred-exit message promises more than execution guarantees
reason: Outside-hours journal says exit will fire next pass, but ordinary conditions are re-evaluated later rather than all being latched.
impact: A price reversal may cancel the later condition despite an earlier apparent promise.
fix: State re-evaluation honestly, or adopt a separately approved persistent-intent policy per exit type; do not automatically latch all targets/stops.
acceptance: Outside-hours signal followed by rebound produces behaviour and wording consistent with chosen policy.

title: Exit pass timestamp does not prove every holding was checked
reason: Session refresh can return after no quotes; successful evaluations and attempted passes are not separately tracked per holding.
impact: A recently run job can mask overdue protection for some or all positions; long scans can delay checks.
fix: Track per-position last successful exit evaluation, quote age, skipped reason and obligation; alert on overdue coverage and bound long scan stages.
acceptance: All quotes missing updates attempts but not successful coverage; one missing name alone becomes overdue.

title: Blank outcome becomes 'passed all gates'
reason: Buy Desk template substitutes passed all gates for missing execution outcome.
impact: An advisory candidate can appear execution-approved even when later gates were never evaluated.
fix: Use No execution verdict recorded; show separate completed/failed/not-evaluated states.
acceptance: Blank outcome and timing=false never render a full-gates pass.

title: Buy Desk preview uses another stream's top50 prices
reason: Momentum candidates are priced from shared last_scan_picks, while submission fetches quotes for the full desk set.
impact: Eligible candidates can appear no_quote/not recommended in preview but execute through a different pricing set.
fix: Use a common dated quote snapshot and candidate universe for preview; recalculate and expose changes at submission.
acceptance: A Momentum candidate missing from Intraday top50 still has an honest consistent preview.

title: Fresh quotes can mask an old shortlist
reason: shortlist checks presence of rows/time, not age; execution reuses old eligibility while repricing.
impact: Yesterday's score/momentum/liquidity can appear current.
fix: Show independent scan, evidence and price ages; define per-stream expiry and refresh/review rules without deleting historical rows.
acceptance: Repricing cannot reset old eligibility age; expired evidence remains clearly labelled.

title: Owner BUY is broader than candle approval
reason: Owner BUY changes mode to Momentum and calls _open via owner sizing/cash policy; ordinary scan gates are bypassed by existing owner design.
impact: An Intraday review action can become an owner/Momentum trade with different exit and budget identity.
fix: Add a separate enter-through-this-stream action that preserves identity and reruns ordinary checks; clearly name any retained broad owner override.
acceptance: Intraday review preserves Intraday exits and normal risk limits; deliberate owner override remains distinct.
proof: Intentional existing policy, not an unauthorized-bypass claim

title: Slippage can exceed the entered Buy Desk budget
reason: Plan caps quote-price cost; execution adds slippage and checks cash without enforcing remaining batch budget.
impact: The stated maximum batch spend can be exceeded.
fix: Size and enforce against estimated fill cost and remaining approved budget; record quote/fill/cost separately.
acceptance: Total spend stays within budget at configured slippage; residual budget refusal is explicit.

title: Owner BUY parser accepts NaN and infinity
reason: abs(float(raw)) with only <=0 checks allows nonfinite values; conversion and custom-level inputs have inconsistent checks.
impact: Malformed inputs can cause errors or nonsensical orders/levels; negative values also silently change sign.
fix: Validate finite bounded numbers and integer quantities before mutation; field-specific errors and explicit negative-input policy.
acceptance: NaN/infinity/extreme/fractional invalid inputs change no portfolio/order state.
proof: Isolated _parse_pos_float accepted NaN and infinity; earlier SELL/manual-add fix is not being reflagged

title: Editing notes can erase system trading identity
reason: Notes form overwrites tags, while owner_pick/buy_desk/ocean control budgets and exit treatment.
impact: Cosmetic edits can alter risk category or re-enable exit behaviour.
fix: Separate system provenance/policy from user labels; deliberate reclassification gets its own audited operation.
acceptance: Clearing user tags cannot remove owner/Ocean identity or alter exit policy.

title: Old day-valid limit order can fill next session
reason: Processing checks market hours and price but relies on a separate callback to expire day orders.
impact: Downtime or missed expiry can leave yesterday's instruction executable today.
fix: Store explicit session expiry and enforce it on every processing attempt and startup; define after-hours/weekend validity.
acceptance: Miss expiry callback, restart next session and touch limit: old order expires rather than fills.
proof: Injected Nov2 order was passed to fill when processing Nov3

title: Partial success hides refusals in scan headline
reason: stopped_by returns bought N if any opened; zero-pick wording can infer timing/liquidity when a global gate emptied candidates.
impact: The headline cannot explain what stopped the remainder or may name the wrong rule family.
fix: Always render the full funnel and both bought/refused counts from stored first-stop codes.
acceptance: 10 opens plus11 refusals shows both; closed-market block is identified directly.

title: Cross-stream gate history is overwritten or truncated
reason: Shared matrix/latest fields overwrite each other; summaries cap names/reason types and some journal lists at20.
impact: Counts may be correct while a complete share-by-share explanation is unrecoverable.
fix: Persist immutable per-run/per-stream decisions separately from portfolio; summaries link to full records with source/policy versions.
acceptance: Sequential streams and large refusal batches retain complete downloadable rows and explicit not-evaluated gates.

title: Rejected settings can partly change live configuration
reason: Mode mutates before universe validation; scalar fields mutate as parsed and finite/range validation is incomplete.
impact: A refused or invalid form can leave runtime behaviour different from what was saved or shown.
fix: Parse and validate a full proposed configuration, then apply atomically under lock; reject invalid/unverifiable fields before mutation.
acceptance: Invalid universe or nonfinite field leaves mode, settings and runtime state unchanged.

title: Settings success is not tied to durable save
reason: save_settings returns no acknowledgement and catches write errors; callers proceed with success redirects/reload.
impact: Owner can believe a policy is saved when it may disappear after restart.
fix: Return an explicit acknowledged result; distinguish active-in-memory, durable and failed states; do not show saved on failure.
acceptance: Injected database refusal displays failure and preserves/rolls back state according to declared atomic contract.

title: Buy Desk first60 limit affects execution as well as display
reason: shortlist truncates to MAX_NAMES and both preview/submission use that set.
impact: Owner may interpret a page limit as having no effect on the batch candidate universe.
fix: Keep bounded processing but disclose total eligible, considered set and ranking cutoff; add pagination/export and explicit batch selection.
acceptance: More than60 candidates shows exactly which are included in the proposed batch and why others are outside it.

title: No editable per-stream advisory policy map
reason: Den displays candle policies, but ordinary editable settings omit those controls; support signals and blockers are scattered.
impact: The owner cannot easily see or govern which optional signals actually stop trades.
fix: Show each rule as advisory/required/not-applicable, its scope, current value, approver and effective version; apply changes with impact preview.
acceptance: Policy shown in UI matches engine/backtest configuration after save/reload; missing candle never becomes hidden score veto.

title: Policy changes need a saved-candidate comparison
reason: Removing one early gate does not show whether later checks, budget or changing quotes would permit a buy.
impact: Counting all former candle refusals as extra buys overstates benefit and hides extra exposure.
fix: Run current versus advisory policy on identical dated candidates and isolated books; report later blockers, costs, drawdown and outcome distributions on later unseen periods.
acceptance: Comparison records data/code/config identity, avoids future data and never places production orders.

title: Pattern count is not independent confidence
reason: 34 patterns include overlapping bullish/bearish/neutral shapes; no evidence supports simply adding arbitrary points for every match.
impact: More names can create apparent certainty or a new indirect selection veto.
fix: Group related evidence, show supportive/conflicting/neutral/unavailable with timeframe and completed-bar time; calibrate any ranking effect separately.
acceptance: Several correlated patterns do not masquerade as independent votes; absent pattern does not penalize base eligibility.

title: Freshness is not tied to the expected completed trading session
reason: Store acceptance uses an end-date calendar cutoff and reconstructed frames, not an explicit per-purpose completed-session contract.
impact: A generic age threshold can hide missed trading bars or future/partial-bar problems; no occurrence is claimed here.
fix: Validate actual last bar, expected completed session, timezone, future dates and market calendar; display distinct age for signals, marks and execution.
acceptance: Weekend/holiday, missing-session, future-date and unfinished-bar fixtures yield explicit availability states.
proof: Design hardening proposal based on current cutoff mechanism
